review.summary: The diff coherently adds v3 per-job allowed_tools with strip/restore prepare projection, tools/list filtering, receipted broker denial, and CompletedFailure only after model/transport/export↔receipt/cleanup qualify—without visibly relaxing foreign/native, drift, divergence, or uncertain-cleanup Refused paths—but hashed current_sources omit contracts/foundry/tests/docs, and observed_checks are unbound claims, so integration is not yet evidence-complete.
